docs.text: Deployment ¶ For local development, run the API on loopback: uv sync uv run uvicorn casapi.main:app --host 127 .0.0.1 --port 8000 For remote deployments, configure TLS, authentication, rate limits, workspace isolation, and least-privilege execution before exposing any agent execution API. These controls are not implemented in the scaffold. Running Claude Agent SDK workloads also requires an appropriate Claude authentication mechanism and an isolated execution workspace.

docs.text: REST API ¶ GET /health ¶ Reports HTTP server readiness. curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/health Expected response: { "status" : "ok" } FastAPI automatically generates documentation at /docs and /openapi.json . Security: this health endpoint is not an agent-execution capability. Do not expose a future execution endpoint without authentication, authorization, workspace confinement, and tool-permission restrictions.
